name: Logs Analysis Agent
description: An autonomous LangGraph agent that fetches application logs from MongoDB, analyzes performance bottlenecks and errors (including nested business/context metadata), validates its own findings, and produces a Markdown analysis report.
download_url: TBD - agent.exe not built yet (PyInstaller packaging pending)
tasks_capable_of_performing: Fetch application logs from MongoDB by level, user, organization, request, date range, or business/context fields
Detect slow operations and error patterns
Surface business context (e.g. orderId, amount) tied to specific errors or slow operations
Validate its own analysis against the raw logs before reporting (evaluator + retry loop)
Generate a structured Markdown log analysis report
examples_of_suitable_questions: הצג לי את כל השגיאות של היום
מה קרה להזמנה עם מזהה ORD-12345?
הצג שגיאות שבהן הסכום גבוה מ-100

technical_specifications.llm_provider: OpenAI (default) or OpenRouter, selectable via LLM_PROVIDER env var
